subject: Multi-tranche renewal and capacity addendum — paperwork & signpath
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@hypervanta.com>, Raj Patel <raj@hypervanta.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-tranche renewal and capacity addendum — paperwork & signpath

Samantha / Raj —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, HyperVanta is moving to a two-tranche renewal (12 month + optional 12 month extension) and wants a formal addendum to capture the stepped capacity increases + a short-term pricing band for burst usage through Q4. I attached a first-pass addendum (HV-Draft-Addendum_v1.docx) that maps to the order summary we reviewed.

Ask from our side: can you confirm procurement's preferred sign path (single DocuSign envelope vs. staged signers) and whether legal needs full redlines to the MSA or a separate addendum-only approach? If HyperVanta prefers an MSA-level redline, we'll route to Legal here for markups.

Timeline proposal:
- Fri 4/2: share Redwood's addendum draft (attached)
- Tue 4/6: receive HyperVanta comments
- Wed 4/7: Redwood legal returns consolidated redline and MAP (mutual-action-plan)
- Thu 4/8: finalize signpath and issue DocuSign

I've cc'd Monica and Markus from Legal/Ops to pick up the redline work and confirm signing logistics.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego.Fernandez@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: HV-Draft-Addendum_v1.docx (addendum stub: tables for tranche quantities, pricing bands, effective dates)

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@hypervanta.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>, Raj Patel <raj@hypervanta.com>
Cc: HyperVanta Procurement <procurement@hypervanta.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-tranche renewal and capacity addendum — paperwork & signpath

Diego —

Appreciate the draft. Procurement prefers a single DocuSign envelope if possible; that speeds internal routing. Legal will want to see redlines to the MSA for any changes to auto-renew or termination language, but for the capacity/price bands they usually accept an addendum only.

Two notes from our side after a quick pass:
- Can you add a short grace-period clause for the first tranche (30 days) to allow us to onboard usage spikes?
- We will ask for a one-time conversion credit if we commit to the 24-month path up front — procurement will flag that as a separate commercial ask to leadership.

Raj is on copy (finance/procurement). We'll try to get initial comments to you by EOD Tuesday 4/6.

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of Cloud Partnerships | HyperVanta
samantha.li@hypervanta.com

--
Samantha Li
HyperVanta
Attachment referenced: none

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@hypervanta.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-tranche renewal and capacity addendum — paperwork & signpath

Diego / Markus / Samantha —

Thanks for the draft, Diego, and the clarifying notes, Samantha. Legal reviewed HV-Draft-Addendum_v1 and prepared a focused redline that keeps the MSA intact wherever possible; attached is redlined_MSA_HyperVanta_v2.docx. High-level changes we recommend:

1) Term and Renewal:
   - Replace blanket auto-renew with a 30-day advance notice window for the optional second tranche. This preserves HyperVanta's runway for budget approvals while preventing accidental renewals.

2) Termination for Convenience (TFC):
   - Limit TFC to pro-rata refund for unused prepaid committed tokens; exclude credits issued for performance remediation.

3) Capacity & Burst Pricing: 
   - Add a capped burst rate for first 30 days of each tranche (grace period) as Samantha requested. The addendum should specify an absolute ceiling to avoid surprises.

4) Data Retention / Audit:
   - Minor clause to confirm audit logs retention for renewal-related invoices (12 months).

5) Signature mechanics:
   - Agree to single-envelope DocuSign. We recommend including a sign order: HyperVanta legal -> HyperVanta procurement -> Redwood signatory. Will Hannah coordinate signer assignment?

I've left inline comments about specific clause language and an alternative if HyperVanta insists on full MSA replacement language. If they send MSA-level redlines, we'll need an extra turn (adds ~2 business days).

Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: redlined_MSA_HyperVanta_v2.docx (document stub with inline comments)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@hypervanta.com>, Raj Patel <raj@hypervanta.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Multi-tranche renewal and capacity addendum — paperwork & signpath

Thanks all — quick consolidation and proposed mutual action plan attached (mutual-action-plan-20270407.xlsx). Plan summary:

- 4/7 (today): Redwood legal posts consolidated redline (Monica done) and MAP (attached).
- 4/8: HyperVanta returns final commercial comments (credit ask + any MSA redlines).
- 4/9: Redwood responds to commercial comments and issues single DocuSign envelope.
- 4/12: Target signature and effective date for tranche 1.

On signership: Hannah, can you own the DocuSign envelope setup and confirm Redwood's signer? We will name our VP of Revenue Ops as signatory unless Legal recommends otherwise.

Samantha — on the conversion credit ask: happy to surface the request to pricing; to keep timelines tight, if HyperVanta can indicate a target credit range (ballpark), that helps expedite internal approvals.

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-20270407.xlsx (MAP stub with owners/dates)

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@hypervanta.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@hypervanta.com>, HyperVanta Procurement <procurement@hypervanta.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Multi-tranche renewal and capacity addendum — paperwork & signpath

Forwarding internally —

Diego / Monica / Hannah —

We reviewed Monica's redline and broadly agree with the approach. HyperVanta is prepared to accept the addendum path (not full MSA rewrite) provided the following are added:

- A one-time conversion credit in the range of $30k - $50k if we sign the full 24-month commitment within this window.
- The 30-day grace period for first-tranche burst with an explicit cap (we propose 150% of baseline committed tokens).

Procurement (cc'd) will confirm internal signer list by tomorrow morning. We'll accept the single-envelope DocuSign flow.

If Redwood can confirm the credit range is feasible, we can aim to return final comments Thursday 4/8.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Head of Cloud Partnerships | HyperVanta
